description: This file contains CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) computation functions, including a CRC-8 calculation (`calc_crc`) and CRC-32 functions (`crc32`, `crc32inc`). It defines a polynomial for CRC-8, includes a lookup table for CRC-32, and provides an API to compute CRC checksums, likely used for data integrity verification within the firmware.

methods.name: calc_crc
methods.description: Calculates an 8-bit CRC over a message array using modulo-2 division with a specified polynomial.

methods.name: crc32
methods.description: Calculates a 32-bit CRC for a buffer, using the incremental CRC calculation function.

methods.name: crc32inc
methods.description: Performs an incremental 32-bit CRC calculation over a buffer, updating the CRC value. Supports multiple calls to process data in chunks.
